name: Obligation 9
definition: Provides information like the identification of the party or parties associated with the collateral agreement, the exposure type and the valuation date.

PartyA.name: Party A
PartyA.definition: Defines one of the entities associated with the collateral agreement.

ServicingPartyA.name: Servicing Party A
ServicingPartyA.definition: Specifies the party that is acting on behalf of party A and that offers collateral management services.

PartyB.name: Party B
PartyB.definition: Defines the other entity associated with the collateral agreement.

ServicingPartyB.name: Servicing Party B
ServicingPartyB.definition: Specifies the party that is acting on behalf of party B and that offers collateral management services.

CollateralAccountIdentification.name: Collateral Account Identification
CollateralAccountIdentification.definition: Provides additional information on the collateral account of the party delivering/receiving the collateral.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of collateral account for digital assets.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area or type of trade causing the collateral movement.

ValuationDate.name: Valuation Date
ValuationDate.definition: Indicates the close of business date on which the initiating party is valuing the margin call.

CollateralAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rul.definition: If CollateralAccountIdentification is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

CollateralAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rul.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, CollateralAccountIdentification must be absent.
